scholarships.name: Alumni Scholarships
scholarships.description: Open to Sommet Education (Les Roches/Glion/Ecole Ducasse) alumni and children of Sommet Education alumni. Any child of a Sommet Education institution (Les Roches/Glion) alumnus is offered a 5% scholarship applying to their program’s tuition fees. Please ensure to mention the full name of the alumnus

scholarships.name: Family Scholarships
scholarships.description: The family scholarship applies when two or more children (siblings, twins) of the same family apply to Sommet Education institutions (Les Roches/Glion/Ecole Ducasse). The second child (and any following children) to enroll will receive a 5% scholarship on tuition for the remainder of their studies.
